background: Abu Dhabi Commercial Bank is the second-largest bank in Abu Dhabi, majority-owned by the emirate's government through its investment vehicle, with a retail, corporate and Islamic banking franchise concentrated in the UAE.
synthesis: Rated A+ on average across all three, all three on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 14 Mar 2025. The site holds no regulatory capital or liquidity figures for the bank, so the case for a deposit rests on the ratings, which sit in the single-A range with no outlook pointing either way. No rating action has been taken in the last 90 days.
